## Working with structures

- Chemometrics is the application of mathematics and statistics to chemical *measurements*<br><br>

- Cheminformatics is the application of mathematics and statistics to chemical *information*

## Structures as human-defined information

- ALL structural representations of chemicals are **human-defined**, for example
    - we've defined atoms with 1 neutron as hydrogen, 16 neutrons as oxygen, etc.
    - we've decided that we can represent atoms with latin alphabet
    - we've decided that we can represent chemical structures ...
        - names (and synonyms)
        - IUPAC names
        - drawings (2D, 3D)
        - molecular formulas
        


::: {.notes}

:::
